SELECT
category AS group_code, category AS group_name, config_code AS group_code, config_name AS group_name, COALESCE(loss_category,'NONE') AS group_code, COALESCE(loss_category,'NONE') AS group_name, 'TOTAL' AS group_code, '合计' AS group_name,
COUNT(*) AS event_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_pause_required) AS auto_pause_required_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_pause_required AND NOT production_paused AND pause_outcome IN ('FAILED_UNKNOWN','MDM_CONFIRMED_MES_FAILED')) AS pause_failure_count, COALESCE(SUM(affected_wip_qty),0) AS affected_wip_qty, COALESCE(SUM(released_wip_qty),0) AS released_wip_qty, COALESCE(SUM(rework_wip_qty),0) AS rework_wip_qty, COALESCE(SUM(scrap_wip_qty),0) AS scrap_wip_qty, COALESCE(SUM(loss_amount),0) AS loss_amount, COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (close_time-trigger_time))/60) FILTER (WHERE close_time IS NOT NULL AND trigger_time IS NOT NULL),0) AS average_close_minutes FROM mes_change_point_handle WHERE del_flag='0' AND factory_code=#{factoryCode} AND trigger_time>=#{startTime} AND trigger_time<#{endTime} AND affected_wip_qty IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY category ORDER BY loss_amount DESC, event_count DESC GROUP BY config_code,config_name ORDER BY loss_amount DESC, event_count DESC GROUP BY COALESCE(loss_category,'NONE') ORDER BY loss_amount DESC, event_count DESC
